faqs.title: What is Old Town Christmas Festival about?
faqs.content:

For more information about Old Town Christmas Festival, please visit visitleandertx.com

faqs.title: How to schedule for the Old Town Christmas Festival event?
faqs.content:
Please visit tisocial.com/otcf23/

Click on the "Buy Now" link to view all the events, games and offers available for schedule.

In the event page, please select the event game to schedule and go the event game page.

Select number of slots from available slots and click on "Add to Cart"

Proceed to checkout and payment by going to your cart page

faqs.content:

The email notifcation includes details about your event schedule, registration, ticket and payment.

For more information about registration and participation in the event, please contact 855-FUN-4ALL

faqs.content: To cancel or reschedule your Old Town Christmas Festival event registration, please contact 855-FUN-4ALL

faqs.title: Did not recieve any notification after registration was successful?
faqs.content:

For more information about registration and participation in the event, please contact 855-FUN-4ALL

faqs.title: What payment methods are supported?
faqs.content:
All major credit card and debit cards are supported.

VISA, MasterCard are accepted.

faqs.title: Why payment transaction failed during registration?
faqs.content:
Please check the billing information provided during registration are correct.

The billing information should be the details registered in the card or bank account used for the payment.
